Agent-side DSH host plugin, installed on every backend a hub should reach.

It publishes this process's launch token + identity to `$DSH_HOME/remote-agent.json`
(0600, atomic w

rite), refreshes it every 60 s, and removes it on shutdown. The token is generated
per process and n

ever persisted by dsh itself, so this file is the clean way for a hub to mint the
browser cookie wit
hout scraping `journalctl` or pasting tokens by hand.

The hub reads `token` and `webPort` over ssh. Without this plugin, use an inline `token` or a

## Lifecycle and security

- Startup publishes immediately; a missing token retries for up to ~10 s, then the 60 s heartbeat

eps retrying.
- The file is 0600; a missing parent directory is created 0700 (existing permissions u

ntouched).
- Graceful shutdown removes the file. A crash leaves a stale file; the hub probe fails an
